title: حوكمة سلسلة توريد التعليمات
rule:
Applies when: When loading skills, plugins or guidance.
Before adopting or loading external skills, plugins, tools or guidance, assess origin, pinned version, license, dependencies, trust, task fit, permissions, side effects and rollback. Distinguish discovery, installation, activation and qualification; use a single canonical project record and prevent silent replacement of governing instructions.
rationale: تعليمات أو مهارة خارجية قد ترفع السلطة أو تستبدل المرجعية. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
